get_data_info_monocular: get data info dict with image filename and lidar2img matrices for a given index
get_matrices_intrinsic_extrinsic: get intrinsic and extrinsic camera calibration matrices from data info at a given index
get_cat_ids_by_index: get category ids as a list for annotations at a specified data index
evaluate_multiview_results: evaluate multi-view detection results with configurable IoU threshold and optional visualization output
evaluate_angles_and_layout: evaluate pitch and roll angle MAE plus layout IoU for total multi-view dataset results
